prompts.context: Some people believe that students learn better in small classes, while others argue that class size matters less than teaching quality.
prompts.prompt: Which view do you agree with? Explain your position with reasons and examples. Write 120-180 words.

prompts.context: Many cities are considering banning private cars from their centres.
prompts.prompt: Do you support such a ban? Give reasons for your answer. Write 120-180 words.

prompts.context: Some employers now ask candidates to complete tasks generated and assessed automatically, without a human interviewer.
prompts.prompt: Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of this practice, and state your own view. Write 120-180 words.

prompts.context: It is sometimes claimed that learning a foreign language is less useful now that translation tools are widely available.
prompts.prompt: To what extent do you agree? Support your answer with reasons. Write 120-180 words.

rubric.label: Task response
rubric.description: Answers the question actually asked, states a clear position, and stays within the word range.

rubric.label: Development
rubric.description: Each reason is supported with an explanation or example, not just asserted.

rubric.label: Organisation
rubric.description: Clear paragraphing: introduction with the position, body paragraphs, short conclusion.

rubric.label: Grammatical range and accuracy
rubric.description: Correct tenses and agreement, with some variety in sentence structure rather than all simple sentences.

rubric.label: Vocabulary
rubric.description: Precise word choice, including academic connectors. Repetition of the same basic words lowers the score.

rubric.label: Cohesion
rubric.description: Linking words used accurately — however, therefore, in contrast — so the logic between sentences is explicit.
